population: 84 first-year master's students who commuted at least three days per week
main_finding: Students offered a quiet campus writing room submitted 18 percent more weekly drafts than students offered the usual shared space
limitation: The study ran for six weeks at one urban university and did not measure writing quality
evidence_quote: Students offered a quiet campus writing room submitted 18 percent more weekly drafts than students offered the usual shared space.

population: twelve laboratory technicians from three university departments
main_finding: Participants most often described uncertainty about who owned a repair request
limitation: Because supervisors recruited the participants, technicians with negative experiences may have declined to take part
evidence_quote: Participants most often described uncertainty about who owned a repair request.

population: doctoral candidates in a weekly peer-methods clinic and a wait-list comparison group
main_finding: Clinic participants were more likely to submit a preregistration, but the groups did not differ in self-rated research confidence
limitation: Students chose whether to attend, so unmeasured motivation could explain part of the difference
evidence_quote: At the end of eight weeks, clinic participants were more likely to submit a preregistration, but the groups did not differ in self-rated research confidence.

population: graduate students from the schools of design, public health, and engineering
main_finding: Booking logs suggested shorter median wait times during on-demand weeks
limitation: The short alternating schedule may have introduced carryover between conditions
evidence_quote: Booking logs suggested shorter median wait times during on-demand weeks.
